description:
Alarm component.

The alarm triggers when local time matches the `time` attribute.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Base CSS font size used by the display and its icons, for example 16px, 1rem or 1.5em.

events.name: tp-alarm-trigger
events.description: Emitted when the alarm is triggered.

cssproperties.name: --tp-alarm-alert
cssproperties.description: Text color of the time display when the alarm rings; also colors its border.

cssproperties.name: --tp-alarm-alert-bg
cssproperties.description: Background color while the alarm rings.

cssproperties.name: --tp-alarm-muted
cssproperties.description: Text color of the time display while stopped.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

dependencies.name: tp-icon
dependencies.summary: SVG icon component with inline, URL, and registry sources.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-alarm>` element implements the <tp-icon name="alarm" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Alarm functionality: alarm component with stop control and optional ring.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Alarm time | Choose the time at which the alarm should ring. |
| Start alarm | Start the alarm. Sound may require browser permission or an initial interaction. |
| Stop alarm | Stop the alarm. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activate the focused button. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
